swayable.summary: The video runs through several news stories from February 17, 2026, covering topics like Jesse Jackson's death, CBS censorship, ICE detention, and the Epstein files. It is delivered as a fast-paced narrated news roundup with a clear left-leaning editorial slant.
swayable.title: Top News Stories You Need to Know — Feb 17, 2026
